verdict.rationale: gstack's automations are skill files that live in a git checkout; dev mode symlinks the repo into `.claude/skills/`, which implies git-based versioning. The `/learn` skill lets users review, search, prune, and export accumulated learnings, and the upgrade skill shows what's new on update. Codified scripts and per-site domain skills can be promoted from project to global scope. There is no documented versioning, diff review, or rollback for the skills or automations themselves. Missing for 10: explicit versioning of skills/codified scripts, diff-based review of automation changes, a rollback or pin-to-previous-version mechanism, independent corroboration.
